encoding: Flatten [20,6] official float32 model arm features raw*0.05; gripper and padded arm excluded. Model has no dataset z-scoring. Primary distance is Euclidean in these 120 model-input coordinates.
support_labels: Descriptive calibration against real chunk leave-one-out distances: well-supported <= P75; borderline P75-P95; weakly supported > P95. Sensitivity analyses at P50 and P90. These are reference quantiles, not proven IID/OOD boundaries.
NN_exclusion: Exclude the base demo index for every alpha, including alpha1. Secondary task-restricted NN also reported.
source_scope: All cached LIBERO demonstrations (six task files); not the complete model training distribution.
